Where two regions meet, the leaf colours interlock naturally: flakes of one reach into the other and the two colours simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every sheet of leaf applied to her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: full frontal, both hands framing the face, chin raised, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme curvy petite silhouette ever displayed.
